shortBiography_1: My name is {{name}}, but you can call me <highlight>{{nickname}}</highlight>. Based in Malang, East Java, I am an ICT Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer with 11+ years of experience building and managing enterprise infrastructure end-to-end.
shortBiography_2: My career began at PT. Telkom Akses (2015–2024), where I handled fiber optic networks, service provisioning, and grew from a field technician into a Team Leader managing a cross-area technician team — maintaining an order completion SLA of ≥85% across East Java.
shortBiography_3: I expanded into software development through a project-based engagement at <highlight>Yukti ID</highlight>, where I built a full-stack blog platform using Next.js, Express.js, and MySQL — designing the application architecture, backend API, database schema, and responsive frontend.
shortBiography_4: I further sharpened my development skills through an intensive 6-month bootcamp at Harisenin.com, covering frontend, backend, databases, and software engineering fundamentals.
shortBiography_5: Currently, I work at PT. Gudang Baru Berkah as a DevOps Engineer (ICT NIS — Network, Infrastructure & Security), managing 30+ VMs on Proxmox VE and 30+ branch network connectivity. I designed the enterprise multi-site network with VLAN segmentation, OSPF/BGP routing, and SD-WAN Ruijie Anylink, and rebuilt the full-stack observability platform from scratch using Zabbix + Grafana + Alloy + Prometheus + Loki.
shortBiography_6: I also implemented a layered security architecture (Cloudflare WAF → MikroTik ACL → NGINX Proxy Manager) achieving A+ on Qualys SSL Labs and SecurityHeaders.com, a DNS split-brain with PowerDNS + DNSSEC, Bitwarden for secrets management, Teleport for SSH/RDP audit, and developed in-house tools — including an NMS real-time display, asset management platform for 30+ branches, and GLPI ITSM with ITIL workflow.
shortBiography_7: I am always open to collaboration and knowledge sharing. If you are interested in working together, feel free to reach out through the {{contact}} section below.
shortBiography_8: This website was built inspired by Frans Jesky on {{name}}.

current.title: PT. Gudang Baru Berkah
current.position: DevOps Engineer | ICT NIS – Network, Infrastructure & Security
current.description: Responsible for building and managing enterprise IT infrastructure end-to-end — from network design and server virtualization, to full-stack observability, layered security architecture, and internal application development. Handles 30+ VMs and 30+ branch connectivity, from design phase to go-live.

responsibilities.title: Network & Connectivity
responsibilities.details: Designed and operates a multi-site enterprise network: VLAN segmentation, OSPF/BGP routing, and tunneling migration from SSTP over EoIP to SD-WAN Ruijie Anylink (Hub-Spoke) for 30+ branch connectivity. Rebuilt IPAM and VLAN design with zero IP conflicts; configured MikroTik (CCR2004, CCR1009, RB750): VLAN, firewall, OSPF, BGP, DHCP, port forwarding. Implemented WireGuard VPN with internal user provisioning.

responsibilities.title: Server & Virtualization
responsibilities.details: Manages 30+ VMs on Proxmox VE: lifecycle management, VLAN bridge, resource planning, backup and cleanup. Planned DRC topology using Proxmox Replication for disaster recovery and mini data center commissioning.

responsibilities.title: Monitoring & Observability
responsibilities.details: Rebuilt full-stack observability from scratch: Zabbix + Grafana OSS + Grafana Alloy + Prometheus + Loki — single NOC dashboard for all infrastructure and internal applications. Developed NMS-TV: real-time monitoring display via WebSocket in the NOC room (VM status, active alerts, WAN status 24/7) with automatic alerting to messaging apps. Coverage: 30+ VMs, network devices, UPS, Synology NAS, EVS CCTV, IP PBX, and internal applications.

responsibilities.title: Security Architecture
responsibilities.details: Implemented layered gatekeeper: Cloudflare WAF+DDoS+SSL as edge → MikroTik ACL (src-address Cloudflare only) → NGINX Proxy Manager for SSL termination and security headers — achieving A+ on Qualys SSL Labs and SecurityHeaders.com for all GBB Group public domains. DNS split-brain with PowerDNS Recursor + Authoritative + PowerAdmin; DNSSEC active, wildcard SSL auto-renewal via DNS-01 challenge. Bitwarden Secrets Manager, Teleport bastion host for SSH/RDP audit, and active SOC lab (Wazuh SIEM + MISP + IRIS) in finalization towards production.

responsibilities.title: Internal Services & Application Development
responsibilities.details: Setup and operation of Asterisk-based IP PBX: SIP trunk Telkom Indibiz, IVR, Ring Group, Call Queue, Voicemail. Synology NAS enterprise configuration: RBAC per user/group/folder, SSL, backup schedule. Developed in-house tools: NOC real-time display (WebSocket), asset management platform for 30+ branches (site history, device inventory, photo documentation, PDF/Excel export), and GLPI ITSM with ITIL workflow, RBAC, automation rules, and analytics dashboard. Resolved domain takeover incident and redocumented all company domains.
